Hi Alice,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to meet you and the team. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on the differences between Hosted API, Dedicated capacity, and Private VPC/on-prem for FinSecure's use cases.

1) Recap of what I heard:
- You process regulated financial documents with PII and need strict data isolation, auditability, and customer-managed keys.
- The security team is concerned about multi-tenant exposure and wants end-to-end control of data.
- Procurement is looking for a clear timeline and cost delta vs a hosted solution.

2) High-level recommendation:
- Given the data isolation and KMS requirements, Private VPC (customer-managed VPC or on-prem) is the likely fit. Dedicated capacity improves performance and isolation from other customers but still uses Redwood-managed network unless you choose Private.

3) What Private VPC gives you vs Dedicated:
- VPC: private network peering or VPN, isolated subnets, optional air-gapped on-prem deployment.
- Customer-managed KMS/HSM support and optional control plane separation for enterprise plans.
- Audit logs and per-request tracing retained to your retention policy; SOC2 evidence available.

4) Next steps I propose:
- I'll loop in Marissa (solutions engineering) to provide a short security appendix that answers: KMS integration, audit log retention, node tenancy, and our SOC2 scope.
- We can schedule a 30-min security deep-dive with your InfoSec next week.
- I'll prepare a preliminary cost/timeline estimate for Private VPC vs Dedicated.

I attached a short matrix that summarizes Dedicated vs Private options and what features each delivers (Redwood_Dedicated_vs_Private_VPC_Matrix.pdf).

Is next Wednesday (7/8) at 10:00 PT for a security call ok? Also please confirm procurement contact so I can send the initial paperwork.

Best,

Hi Alice — looping in the answers inline and attaching our SOC2 report (redacted):

On Tue, Jun 30, 2026 at 11:02 AM Alice Thompson <alice@finsecure.com> wrote:
> - Do Private VPC and on-prem deployments support customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS, GCP CMEK, or HSM integrations)?

Yes. Private VPC and our on-prem package both support customer-managed KMS integrations. Options:
- Cloud KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP CMEK) for keys used to encrypt model checkpoints and persisted stores.
- HSM/KMS proxy for on-prem HSMs (we can support PKCS#11 workflows; customer manages key material).

> - For Private VPC, are there any shared control plane nodes or metadata services that could expose tenant identifiers?

Short answer: no shared data plane tenancy.
- Data plane (inference nodes) is isolated to your VPC or on-prem cluster. There is an optional control plane (hosted) for management; for enterprise Private deployments we can offer a dedicated control plane or self-hosted control plane to avoid metadata exposure.
- We do not co-locate customer inference workloads on the same nodes as other tenants when Private VPC/on-prem is selected.

> - Do you provide audit logs with per-request identifiers and the ability to stream logs to our SIEM? What retention options exist?

Yes.
- We emit per-request logging and request IDs; logs can be streamed to your SIEM via forwarding (syslog/secure forward) or pushed to your cloud log bucket.
- Retention: default is 90 days for hosted; for Private you can configure retention (30/90/365+). Longer retention is part of the enterprise package.

Attachments included: SOC2-report-2025.pdf (redacted).

Estimated timeline and cost ballpark for Private VPC (customer-managed VPC with dedicated control plane):
- Network & onboarding: 2\u20134 weeks (peering, routing, firewall rules)
- Provisioning & testing: 2\u20134 weeks
- Total: 4\u20138 weeks from kickoff (on-prem deployments longer depending on procurement and onsite windows: 6\u201310+ weeks).
- Cost delta vs Dedicated: typically 20\u201340% uplift depending on required SLAs, dedicated control plane, and audit retention. We can provide a precise estimate after we size capacity.

If you'd like, we can do a 30-min security deep-dive next week to walk through architecture diagrams and KMS flows. Mateo — can you propose two slots?

Best,
